title: Socialization Enforcer
description: Forces you to socialize by disabling Singleplayer
body:
Always wanted to be motivated to play multiplayer instead of being sad and alone in singleplayer?
Well this mod has you covered!
By using hyper advanced SpongePowered Mixins(TM) Technologies, singleplayer has been disabled.
Yes!

(this mod is mainly a joke and was created because someone in KaupenJoe's live chat said it)
